candidate_workaround: Build one stage-zero index map with git ls-files -s -z and read all required objects through one git cat-file --batch stream.
failure_signature: The first independent staged-manifest verifier used one Git process per blob and exceeded its 120-second bound before producing a result.
recurrence_guard: Use the batched index/object verifier for manifests above a small bounded fixture; never return to a per-blob subprocess loop.
rollback: Stop, retain the failed witness, and leave external and authority state unchanged.
scope_boundary: Owner-local closeout recovery only; not exact-final or authority credit.
title: Bounded recovery for sequential_manifest_blob_verifier_timeout
